audit.why: 52.45% over 713 games with difficulty 4/10 is right for the lane: Sion has no dash, no burst and an uncharged Decimating Smash does nothing, so levels 1-5 are Fiora's.

audit.whatIsWrong: First item and 2+ items were both given away from Sion (Skill and Fiora), contradicting the packet chart and the page's own whys[5]/whys[6]/late.
audit.why: whys[5] says 'a smart Sion freezes and scales past your window' and whys[6] says 'Full-tank Sion soaks your DPS'. The packet chart already reads Sion for both rows.
audit.corrected: First item -> Sion, 2+ items -> Sion, with phases[5].why and phases[6].why rewritten to state why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names Sion's abilities except Decimating Smash (a defect the packet flags) and describes Soul Furnace only as 'his W shield'.
audit.why: Riot text: Soul Furnace 'shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby' — a fixed 3-second window you can simply not be standing in. Roar of the Slayer 'damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit', and knocks a minion back through you if it hits one first, which is his real poke. Glory in Death makes a killed Sion reanimate with rapid attacks that heal him and scale off your maximum health, so trading with the corpse is a losing proposition and Grievous Wounds matters.
audit.corrected: Name Roar of the Slayer's armour shred and Soul Furnace's 3-second detonation; treat Glory in Death as a healing reanimation to walk away from.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' and no ability cooldown is stated on the page.
audit.why: Decimating Smash is 10/9/8/7/6s, Soul Furnace 15/14/13/12/11s, Roar of the Slayer 12/11/10/9/8s, and Unstoppable Onslaught drops to 60s at rank 3.
audit.corrected: Charged = knockup, 10s at rank 1. Engage in the window right after he releases it.

edits.before: Ravenous Hydra is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Decimating Smash's cooldown.
edits.after: Sion's first tank item: Soul Furnace and his passive out-last your burst. Force the fight before it lands.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sion carry threat 6/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on, Sion is a map problem: Unstoppable Onslaught is 60s at rank 3 and reaches any lane. Your split has to be faster.

edits.before: His only level-1 tool is the slow E shard and a harmless uncharged Q — your Q-Vital out-trades that for free.
edits.after: Roar of the Slayer slows and shreds armour, but an uncharged Decimating Smash is harmless — your Q-Vital wins free.

edits.before: Stack armor and HP so his W shield and zombie passive out-survive your burst long enough to disengage
edits.after: Soul Furnace shields then detonates three seconds later — he wants you standing on it mid-combo

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Riposte or dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Charged = knockup, 10s at rank 1. Engage in the window right after he releases it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace absorbs your burst and detonates three seconds later.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: A killed Sion reanimates with healing max-HP attacks — buy Executioner's Calling and walk away from the corpse.

notes: Two packet defects addressed: ability names now appear (Roar of the Slayer, Soul Furnace, Unstoppable Onslaught) and real cooldowns are attached. Not asserted, because Riot's text does not say it: whether Sion is unstoppable during Unstoppable Onslaught and therefore whether a Riposte stun can stop the charge. Left out rather than guessed.
